output.summary: An evergreen coniferous shrub or small tree native to western North America. Its dark-blue, wax-coated, berry-like cones usually hold one seed, while its peeling gray-brown bark reveals orange-brown beneath. Historically, Navajo people ate the ripe cones in fall or winter.
output.edibilityNote: Historically, Navajo people ate the ripened cones in fall or winter.
